title: card.played payload, schemaVersion 1
description: A game event from the Shuffler: it deterministically knows a card was played, so it says so. Card identity is the Scryfall ID (definition) plus a Shuffler-minted instance GUID (this particular Forest, for this game). Which seat played it lives on the envelope's initiator, not repeated here. Pre-Spine exception (tabletop-cards-come-and-go, ticket 05): frontImageUrl/backImageUrl/cardName are scaffolding render conveniences, promoted into this schema so ajv can validate the whole body now that zero real senders/receivers exist yet — the same in-place-edit exception envelope.v1 uses, not a new policy. Once a real consumer exists, reshaping this needs a v2.

scryfallId.description: Definition: the exact printing — oracle identity, all faces, all names, all images derivable.

instanceId.description: Instance: this particular physical-ish card, minted per game at game start. Opaque — never the Shuffler's internal gameCardIndex, which is a decodable secret.

face.description: Face is card state, not identity — but MDFCs are played as a chosen face, so it rides along.

zoneHint.description: Where the card is headed on the table. A hint — geography, not rules.

frontImageUrl.description: Blessed scaffolding convenience: render without a Scryfall lookup.

backImageUrl.description: Present (non-null) exactly when the card has a printed back face — null, never omitted, when it doesn't (two-faced-cards watch point 17).

cardName.description: Blessed scaffolding convenience: display without a Scryfall lookup.

owner.description: The seatId of the player this card belongs to. Grants no capability — any player can still move any card; it makes 'whose card is this' a fact the shape carries.

isCommander.description: Whether this card is one of its owner's commanders.
